an3.132:1.3: Pāsāṇalekhūpamo puggalo, paṭhavilekhūpamo puggalo, udakalekhūpamo puggalo.
an3.132:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati,
an3.132:1.6: so ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an3.132:1.7: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave pāsāṇe lekhā na khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
an3.132:1.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati
an3.132:1.9: so ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an3.132:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati,
an3.132:2.3: so ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an3.132:2.4: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave paṭhaviyaṃ lekhā khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
an3.132:2.5: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati
an3.132:2.6: so ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an3.132:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo āgāḷhena pi vuccamāno pharusena pi vuccamāno amanāpena pi vuccamāno sandhīyati c' eva saṃsandati c' eva sammodati c' eva.
an3.132:3.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave udake lekhā khippaṃ yeva paṭigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
an3.132:3.4: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo āgāḷhena pi vuccamāno pharusena pi vuccamāno amanāpena pi vuccamāno sandhīyati c' eva saṃsandati c' eva sammodati c' eva.
an3.132:3.6: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin
